metadata.title: Monochromatic Group Portrait with Geometric Logo

retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic blue-tinted group portrait featuring a staggered depth-of-field arrangement and a bold, geometric red-bordered logo at the bottom.

recipe.visualDefinition: A series of five men in leather jackets arranged in a diagonal line receding into a dark background, all unified by a deep blue color grade and anchored by a heavy, red-framed geometric logo in the lower foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal recession of subjects from right foreground to left background
Monochromatic blue tinting across all photographic elements
High-contrast lighting highlighting facial features and leather textures
Horizontal geometric logo block acting as a visual base
coreInvariants: Deep blue monochromatic color cast on the photography
Staggered head heights creating a rhythmic diagonal
Heavy red rectangular border around the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects staggered diagonally; the rightmost figure is largest in the foreground, scaling down to the leftmost figure in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red rectangular logo block at the bottom center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large foreground face on the right, follows the diagonal line of heads back into the distance, and drops down to the bold red logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black/dark blue void in the upper left and top areas provides breathing room for the dense group arrangement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Navy and Cyan (monochromatic photo tint)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Red (logo border and fill accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photography with high value contrast; high saturation and flat values in the graphic logo.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are constructed from thick, uniform blocks
Negative space within letters is minimal and geometric
Stems and crossbars have equal weight
The 'T' and 'P' feature extended horizontal bars that touch the border
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O's are perfect squares with small central cutouts
The 'R' uses a notched block for the leg

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a red rectangular frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone geometric branding; no secondary type is used to maintain focus on the group identity.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the wide, square skeleton needed for the base.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of five men in black leather jackets, arranged in a diagonal line receding into the background. Apply a deep monochromatic blue tint to the entire image with high contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Create a horizontal red rectangular box at the bottom. Inside, place custom geometric block lettering with a cyan fill, ensuring the letters are thick and touch the red borders.

verificationChecks: Is the logo contained in a thick red rectangle?
Are the letterforms ultra-wide and geometric?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the diagonal
Thickness of the red logo border
mustRedesign: Any specific facial features of the original subjects
The exact unique letterform of the 'R'
Specific brand logos on the clothing

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the foreground subject
Perfectly horizontal and centered logo placement

postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue tint is uniform across all subjects.
Verify the red border is a solid, vibrant primary red.
Ensure the diagonal composition creates a sense of depth.
Confirm the text is legible despite its geometric abstraction.
Check that the leather texture is visible through the blue grade.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic [Color] + Staggered Diagonal Portrait + Geometric Block Logo Overlay
